why: The part moved from the box onto a `<span>` wrapping the drawing and written in capitals, `DATA-PCT-PART="arrow"`. The compiler hands the name on as written and `setAttribute` lowers it on an HTML element: a consumer's `[data-pct-part="arrow"]` matches it, and it goes when a set replaces the drawing. `check-parts` reads the name in any case; this point read it in small letters alone.
